advice.R01: Replace with a generic term like 'A DACH-based B2B SaaS startup'.
advice.R02: Describe roles and experience instead of real names (e.g. 'Experienced tech lead with 8 years in the field').
advice.R03: Remove website links; contacts are only shared upon mutual approval.
advice.R04: Remove direct contact details; contacts are exchanged after approval.
advice.R05: Describe proprietary tech without specific patent numbers.
advice.R06: Replace client names with industry categories (e.g. 'Tier-1 automotive OEM').
advice.R07: Replace city with a region (e.g. 'Southern Germany' or 'DACH region').
advice.default: Rephrase to remove identifying proprietary details.

blockers.required: is required and cannot be empty.
blockers.unconfirmed: has not been confirmed yet (click Confirm).
blockers.blocking_risk: contains an identifying phrase that must be edited or removed.
